questions.question: Zelophehad's daughters were to inherit his land. If they married men from other Israelite tribes, what would happen to the land?

answers.text: It is added to the tribe they marry into
It goes back to Moses to give out again
It is split up among the tribe of Levi

questions.question: Who did the LORD say Zelophehad's daughters could marry?

answers.text: Anyone in a clan of their father's tribe
Only men Moses picks for them
Any man from any tribe of Israel

questions.question: After Moses passed on the LORD's command about whom they could marry, what did Zelophehad's daughters do?

answers.text: They obeyed and did as they were told
They asked Moses to change the ruling
They gave the land to their uncles

questions.question: Through Moses, the LORD said no inheritance in Israel could move from one tribe to another. Why not?

answers.text: Each Israelite keeps his fathers' tribal land
The tribes would start fighting over borders
The lots can never be cast a second time
